# opnsense_syslog_settings (Resource)

General logging settings (System > Settings > Logging). This is a singleton that always exists, so it must be imported before Terraform manages it (`id = "syslog_settings"`); destroying it only removes it from state. Remote targets are `opnsense_syslog_destination`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_syslog_settings.this
  id = "syslog_settings"
}

# Keep 90 days of logs locally, rotating files at 50 MB.
resource "opnsense_syslog_settings" "this" {
  max_preserve  = 90
  max_file_size = 52428800
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Run the local syslog service. Disabling it stops all logging, including remote destinations. Unset keeps the current value.
- `log_local` (Boolean) Write logs to local disk. Unset keeps the current value.
- `max_file_size` (Number) Maximum size of a log file in bytes before it is rotated; 0 means no limit. Unset keeps the current value.
- `max_preserve` (Number) Days of logs to keep. Unset keeps the current value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `syslog_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The singleton always has this ID
terraform import opnsense_syslog_settings.this syslog_settings
```
